title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Our Purpose

At Stackdrop, our mission is to build robust, scalable business software that helps organizations solve unique challenges and unlock new opportunities. We partner with clients to design and deliver tailored solutions that empower their teams, streamline operations, and support growth.

By joining Stackdrop, you’ll be part of a team that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and technical excellence. We believe in pairing strong engineering with thoughtful strategy, enabling our clients to do their best work.

  • Have many careers in one company.

  • Enjoy flexible, practical benefits that support your well-being.

  • Learn and grow alongside engineers, product experts, and business leaders.

What will your typical day look like?

  • Develop and communicate clear product visions and strategies aligned with Stackdrop’s goals.

  • Define and prioritize features based on strategic milestones, user needs, and stakeholder feedback.

  • Create and maintain product roadmaps, providing clarity to both internal teams and external partners.

  • Work hand-in-hand with engineering from concept to launch, ensuring alignment with scope and standards.

  • Lead sprint planning, daily standups, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies.

  • Monitor project timelines and resources, ensuring delivery of high-quality, on-time products.

  • Serve as the bridge between technical and non-technical teams, translating complex ideas into actionable steps.

  • Gather insights from stakeholders and users to drive continuous improvement.

  • Analyze performance metrics to inform decisions that improve product functionality and user experience.

  • Present updates, challenges, and upcoming plans to senior leadership.

  • Stay ahead of new tools, technologies, and methodologies to keep our approach innovative.

About the team

We are a fast-growing software development agency passionate about solving real business problems with technology. From automation platforms to custom-built applications, we bring a mix of engineering precision and creative problem solving.

At Stackdrop, you won’t just manage projects ~ you’ll help shape how we design, build, and deliver impactful solutions. Our flat, collaborative culture means your ideas and leadership will directly influence outcomes.

Enough about us, let’s talk about you

  • Background in computer science, engineering, or related technical field (or equivalent experience).

  • Strong project management skills and ability to lead cross-functional teams.

  • Skilled communicator, comfortable working with both technical and business stakeholders.

  • Analytical thinker with strong problem-solving skills.

  • Experienced in Agile methodologies, including running sprints and retrospectives.

  • Familiar with software development and web technologies.

  • Bonus if you have:

    • Hands-on development experience

    • Experience with ClickUp or similar project management tools

    • Exposure to automation platforms like Zapier, Retool, or workflow orchestration tools

Our promise to you

At Stackdrop, you’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, experiment, and grow. Whether you’re leading a complex deployment, streamlining a workflow, or guiding a client through transformation, your work will directly shape outcomes.

We value curiosity, accountability, and collaboration - and we’re looking for someone who thrives in an environment where no two days look the same.

If you can refactor chaos into clean delivery pipelines, we want you in our commit history 🚀
